text_block_list.text:
I escort Хиши Амадзон to the infirmary
after she
suffers an injury в тренировке.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Come on, I don't need to be patched up.
It's
nothing serious.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We're just wasting time here, so let's get
back to
training.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Let them treat you for my peace of mind.
Let's refocus real quick and then get back at it.

text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, it's not that bad... Ouch.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: So it does hurt after all.

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't—well... it does hurt a little,
but this
should heal up in no time!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We can't put on the brakes every time I
get a
little scuffed up. Sometimes it's
better to push on,
you know?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list:
What if one of your dorm residents said the
same thing?

text_block_list.text:
Well, I would scold her good and make
her rest!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Ah, dang it. You got me there.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll rest up and take care of
myself... You
happy now?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I get your point! I can't let the
others see
me lookin' so pathetic.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I won't push myself too hard, so—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Owww!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Ugh... This isn't good.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I can walk, but running's a whole
different story...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Let's lay off the training till you're better.

text_block_list.text:
All right, all right. I can't be makin' my
injury
worse when I've got so many
students lookin' up
to me as a role
model.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I'll be the one to decide how I—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, I take that back, Teach. Could
you tape
it up for me?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Not exactly, but it feels a bit off.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I need to get back in tip-top shape if I
want to
keep on training.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Plus, I'm always telling the younger
students to
take their injuries seriously.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
After having her injuries treated, she
gives herself
plenty of time to rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон puts her impatience aside
and rests
up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tape up her injury tightly, and we finish
training
without further incident.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
